title: About us
lead: Uniroad helps young people from Uzbekistan get into university in Italy: from choosing a university to the first day in Italy, in plain language and based only on official sources.
services: Advice on choosing a level, field and university
Diploma recognition through DoV or CIMEA
Tasks after arriving in Italy: permesso, codice fiscale, full enrollment

principles.d: Every date, amount and requirement is taken from a university, embassy or ministry page, with the source shown.
We do not guarantee admission or a visa: the university and the embassy decide. We help you do every step correctly and on time.
We explain complex terms in plain language, easy to read on a phone.
It does not end with the application: we answer your questions about the visa, the scholarship and the first weeks in Italy too.
